I extend my Shubho Bijaya wishes to the owner, manager and all the members of P.C. Chandra Jewellers- a jewel of jewels (Balurghat Branch)💎🌾
Needless to say that their ultimate U.S.P  is their proficiency in dealing and amazing behaviour of the staff members in service at BALURGHAT BRANCH...🙏🌷
We were delighted to receive at our doorstep quite surpringly their unique, delicious and tasty Jalbharas as "Shubho bijaya Mishti mukh". These sweets too were as unique as their jewellery collection at their store.
THANK YOU to the  entire team of P.C Chandra Jewellers ( Balurghat Branch) for your courtesy and the love and respect we receive on our each and every visit there. Stay well. I pray  Lord Ganesha  always be with you.

Regards
Your happy customer😊
Arunima Mandal
Raghunathpur
Balurghat

I have bought this for my sister in law, she liked it very much.their customer service is outstanding,packaging is beautiful and of great quality! Their catalog is fabulous.
The behaviour of staff, manager, and guard is so good. Definitely recommending you guys. Go and visit as soon as possible.

It is the new jewellery shop in Balurghat. It is not their owned Shop. It is franchise shop. It was opened on August 2016. Location is just opposite of SBI bazar para Branch of Balurghat on main road near taxi stand. Different shows and discount period happen throughout the year.

It is located near to public bus stand , Balurghat in main road . Good customer friendly atmosphere hear . Vast collection of jewelry which is really important in a town like Balurghat . I think you will enjoy your shopping hear .
Most of the collection in balurghat's store is heavily weighted. There are very few items of low weight. So we want more and more collections to come to our Balurghat store.
